task.title: Configuring quota notifications
task.shortdesc: After you set FEATURE_QUOTA_NOTIFICATIONS to true, you can configure external notification channels to receive alerts when quota thresholds are reached.

ul.li: You have a superuser account so that you can configure the config.yaml file.
You have an account with org:admin access so that you can configure notifications.
You have administrative privileges for the organization or user namespace.

step.cmd: Set FEATURE_QUOTA_NOTIFICATIONS: true in your config.yaml file and then restart your registry.
Configure quota limits for your organization or user namespace. See "Establishing quota for an organization by using the Red Hat Quay UI".
In the Red Hat Quay UI, open your organization or user settings page.
Select one of the following notification events:

ul.li: Quota Warning: Triggers when storage usage crosses a Warning quota limit (quota_warning event).
Quota Error: Triggers when storage usage crosses a Reject quota limit (quota_error event).

step.cmd: Select one of the following notification methods:

ul.li: Email: Sends a notification to an organization contact email or admin email address.
Slack: Sends a notification to a Slack webhook.
Webhook: Sends a notification to a custom webhook URL.
Quay Notification: Creates an in-app notification in Red Hat Quay.

step.cmd: Configure the method-specific settings for your chosen notification method.

ul.li: Verify that the notification shows in the Notifications list for your namespace.
If quota thresholds are exceeded, notifications get sent to configured channels. Check the Failures count to verify notification delivery status.
